papers.title_en: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
papers.authors: Manav Kulshrestha, Apoorva Vashisth, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 直接研究任务导向的机器人六自由度抓取
papers.tldr: 任务导向抓取要求机器人根据用途选择合适部位，例如切面包时握刀柄，递刀时则需避免遮挡刀柄；现有方法受二维抓取、任务无关生成器或有限标注数据限制。TGrasp6D从任务描述和单张RGB-D图像出发，借助视觉语言推理物体的语义可供性，生成抓取先验并优化六自由度位姿，以避开碰撞且保持任务意图。在TaskGrasp数据集上，其成功率达到94%，高于最佳基线的74%。真实机械臂实验也展示了对新物体的零样本泛化，为无需任务专用抓取数据的实用操作提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. This generated prior is further refined via 6DoF pose optimization for collision avoidance while preserving task consistency. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rate of 94% on the TaskGrasp dataset, with the best baseline at 74%. We also deploy our approach on a Franka Research 3 robot to demonstrate zero-shot generalization to real world objects

papers.title_en: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
papers.authors: SenseNova, Joint Research Team, :, Zhongang Cai, Ziang Cao, Tailai Chen, Han Chong Chua, Linjun Dai, Hanming Deng, Hokin Deng, Haiwen Diao, Chenjing Ding, Weichen Fan, Xiao Fu, Zerui Gong, Chenyang Gu, Zexin He, Zhi Hou, Bo Li, Qinyue Li, Quanzhou Li, Xiaowan Li, Zhichao Liao, Dahua Lin, Zilong Lin, Bo Liu, Chunxiao Liu, Pengfei Liu, Tianqi Liu, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy, Lewei Lu, Jiapeng Luo, Yuexiao Ma, Liang Pan, Xingang Pan, Oscar Qian, Ziyi Shang, Yuyao Shao, Dawei Su, Dacheng Tao, Qingyi Tao, Quan Wang, Ruisi Wang, Xiaogang Wang, Ziyi Wang, Beichen Wen, Donghao Wu, Jiaxu Wu, Silei Wu, Xiaoming Wu, Zhonghua Wu, Hongcan Xiao, Weiye Xu, Atsushi Yamashita, Lei Yang, Zhe Yang, Baiqiao Yin, Wanqi Yin, Hanfei Zhao, Tianbo Zhong, Long Zhuo, Jing Zuo
papers.evidence: 在多个机器人操作、导航与身体形态基准上评估具身智能能力
papers.tldr: 机器人研究通常针对不同任务和本体训练专用模型，本报告考察GPT-6-Astra能否跨越这一范式，并区分基准能力与实用智能。作者以训练集演示开展上下文学习，在统一协议下评测覆盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台和灵巧手的12项基准，并分析高层推理与低层控制器的闭环协作。模型取得突出基准表现，但真实部署中的演示采集成本高，延长执行时间也难以克服物理限制。研究据此提出无域内演示、按现实时间计时的基准原型，认为模型已具备广泛的具身能力，实用具身智能仍有距离。
papers.abstract_en: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: VLA-Fabric: Learning Interaction for Composable Multi-Arm VLA Agents
papers.authors: Chenglong Zhang, Shuaijun Liu, Feiyang You, Shuyang Hao, Chengyu Wu, Ningxin Su
papers.evidence: 多臂机器人通过视觉语言动作策略协调并执行操作
papers.tldr: 多臂操作要求各机械臂协同，但现有方法多采用集中式联合策略、任务或角色分配，或让局部策略响应队友；完整的视觉语言动作策略如何在动作生成时彼此交互，仍未充分探索。VLA-Fabric为每条机械臂配置一个完整策略，保留本地感知与动作控制，并学习跨策略边界的信息交互。研究分析了共享上下文、针对队友的潜在信息及动作阶段交互等协同功能，并在不同架构、三臂和四臂团队中验证。四项实体任务的成功率较独立训练的局部策略提高16至40个百分点，显示显式策略交互是构建可组合多臂智能体的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are rapidly expanding what individual robots can accomplish, yet many real-world manipulation settings require multiple arms to operate as a coordinated system. Existing approaches organize multi-arm coordination in different ways, including centralized joint policies, high-level task or role assignment, and locally executed policies that react to teammates. However, how complete action-producing VLAs should explicitly interact with one another during action generation remains largely unexplored. We introduce VLA-Fabric, which organizes one complete VLA per arm while preserving local perception and action ownership, and enables coordination through learned interaction across policy boundaries. We first systematically study where such interaction should occur, how peer information should be aggregated, and how the interaction should be learned, revealing complementary coordination functions spanning shared context, peer-specific latent information, and action-stage interaction. We then re-instantiate these functions in a structurally different VLA architecture, showing that the coordination principle is not tied to a particular tensor layout or backbone implementation. Finally, we compose teams of three and four arms and evaluate them in simulation and physical experiments. On all four physical tasks, Full interaction improves success over independently trained local policies by 16--40 percentage points. Together, these results suggest that explicit interaction among complete VLA policies offers a scalable path toward networked embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: Frame-Consistent Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images
papers.authors: Viruthshaan Vinasirajan, Ranga Rodrigo
papers.evidence: 利用VGGT位姿估计进行稀疏无位姿图像的前馈三维重建
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅可快速合成新视角，但将独立位姿估计器与重建网络串联时常出现质量下降，既有工作主要归因于位姿噪声。作者分析107个场景并开展受控消融，发现关键问题是坐标系不一致和位移尺度偏差，而非旋转误差。通过确定性修正，冻结VGGT与TokenGS在四张上下文图像的稀疏设定下即可达到全视图质量，无需微调或位姿细化。该结果给出简洁的免COLMAP重建流程，并重新界定两阶段集成的主要瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian models have made novel view synthesis almost instantaneous. Feed-forward methods predict Gaussians directly, either in two stages or in a single merged pass. Using two separately trained models is attractive because each can specialize in its own objective: one for accurate pose estimation and the other for high-quality reconstruction, rather than forcing a single jointly trained network to compromise between the two. A natural instantiation pairs a frozen pose estimator, VGGT, with a frozen reconstruction backbone, TokenGS. Prior work, such as VGGT-X and 3R-GS, also adopts a two-stage design, but attributes the resulting quality degradation to noisy pose estimates and introduces learned refinement. We show that this is not the primary source of the problem. Through per-camera analysis across 107 scenes from two datasets, DL3DV and MipNeRF360, using COLMAP poses as the reference, we find that the rotation error after alignment is small (median 1.6 degrees), whereas the translation scale is offset by a large, dataset-consistent factor. Controlled ablations over 140 DL3DV scenes show that the primary obstacles are two integration failures rather than pose error: a coordinate-frame inconsistency and a translation-scale mismatch, both of which can be corrected deterministically. With these fixes, a frozen VGGT driving a frozen TokenGS achieves 22.47 PSNR, within 0.51 dB of the COLMAP reference, with no additional training, when poses are estimated from all scene views. In the sparse setting, where reconstruction uses only four context images under the standard pose-free protocol, the same pipeline matches this all-view quality, yielding a fully COLMAP-free pipeline without any refinement step.

papers.title_en: ORD-WM: Learning Object-Centric Rigid Dynamics for 3D World Modeling in Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Yueyang Weng, Xiaopeng Zhang, Yuxi Ou, Yongjin Mu, Chengzhi Zhao, Yanjie Li
papers.evidence: 为机器人操作学习对象中心的刚体动力学世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人操作需要预测动作如何改变物体状态，但现有图像式和稠密三维世界模型缺少显式刚体运动约束，多步推演容易出现形状漂移或物体运动不一致。ORD-WM采用带符号距离场监督的向量神经元变分自编码器，将点云编码为几何感知的三维向量特征，并预测物体级SE(3)运动增量。模型将刚性变换解析施加于当前潜状态，从而分离持久几何与姿态变化。实验显示其多步预测稳定保形，并支持仿真及真实操作中的实时闭环重规划。
papers.abstract_en: World models provide robots with a predictive mechanism for reasoning about how actions change object states in manipulation tasks. However, existing image-based and dense 3D world models do not explicitly impose object-level rigid motion, leaving rigid-object geometry preservation to be learned implicitly and making multi-step rollouts susceptible to shape drift or object-level motion inconsistency. To address this, we propose ORD-WM, a 3D world model that learns object-centric rigid dynamics for robotic manipulation. ORD-WM learns a vector-neuron variational autoencoder supervised by signed distance fields, which encodes each object point cloud as a geometry-aware latent representation composed of 3D vector features, and uses an action-conditioned dynamics model to predict object-wise SE(3) motion increments. Rather than generating unconstrained next latent states, ORD-WM analytically applies predicted object-wise rigid transformations to the current latent states, separating persistent object geometry from pose changes. Experiments show that ORD-WM enables stable, geometry-preserving multi-step prediction and supports efficient real-time replanning for closed-loop model predictive control in simulated and real-world manipulation scenarios.

papers.title_en: LonGaussian: Tracking Foundation Priors for Long-Context Feedforward Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zhoufeng Xie, Guanjun Wu, Shuai Zhang, Xinggang Wang, Wenyu Liu
papers.evidence: 直接改进长序列前馈三维场景重建
papers.tldr: 从长视频重建高质量、可渲染三维场景，有助于机器人感知与具身智能；但联合处理全部视图显存开销高，逐帧累积预测又会重复表示表面。LonGaussian基于预训练流式重建骨干网络解码长上下文几何特征，并以多帧点轨迹关联重复观测、引导高斯合并，再用渲染深度一致性过滤错误遮挡。实验在DL3DV与RealEstate10K上显示，其新视角渲染质量优于所比较的前馈基线，且高斯数量显著更少。该方法面向已知相机内参、未知相机位姿的长序列，兼顾场景紧凑性与全局可渲染性。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing high-quality, renderable 3D scenes from long videos is essential for robotic perception and embodied intelligence. Many feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction methods rapidly predict 3D scenes from a small set of images, but extending them to longer sequences presents two bottlenecks: jointly processing all views increases GPU memory requirements, while accumulating pixel-aligned predictions redundantly represents the same surfaces and increases storage and rendering costs. We present LonGaussian, a streaming feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact, globally renderable Gaussian scenes from long image sequences with known intrinsics and unknown camera poses. Built on a pretrained streaming 3D reconstruction backbone, LonGaussian decodes long-context geometric features into dense Gaussians. Within each chunk, multi-frame point tracks link repeated observations of the same surface and guide a learned merger to consolidate the corresponding Gaussian predictions. Rendered-depth consistency filtering further suppresses Gaussians from other chunks that incorrectly occlude locally reconstructed surfaces. On DL3DV and RealEstate10K benchmarks, LonGaussian improves novel-view rendering quality while using substantially fewer Gaussians than the evaluated feed-forward baselines.

papers.title_en: FlexPart: Text-Controlled Semantics-Aware 3D Part Segmentation at Flexible Granularity
papers.authors: Yiqun Zhao, Jiachen Xu, Yihao Zhi, Yunfei Zhao, Zibo Zhao, Xintong Han, Chunchao Guo, Shenghua Gao
papers.evidence: 支持按用户指定粒度进行语义感知的三维部件分割
papers.tldr: 三维资产可按不同粒度划分，用户也常只想提取指定部件；现有方法受多粒度数据不足、控制方式不完整限制，难以做到所需即所得。FLEXPART以部件名称及位置、形状描述构成整体控制提示，借助自动视觉语言模型流程生成多粒度训练数据，并预测网格面级、视角无关的部件身份。随机丢弃背景促使模型依据语义而非几何先验分割，推理时还可自动补全描述。实验中各粒度均优于基线，平均交并比提升15%至22%，仅给部件名称时选择性分割提升35%，为自然语言控制三维分割提供了统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: A 3D asset admits multiple valid part decompositions, while semantics-aware segmentation should reflect both the desired granularity and the parts a user wants to extract. Ideally, a practical segmentation   model should strive for a simple principle: what you ask for is what you get. However, realizing this goal is hindered by two core obstacles: the lack of multi-granularity training data and the absence of a   holistic control mechanism. We propose FLEXPART, a unified framework for text-controlled 3D mesh segmentation. To establish flexible control, we introduce a holistic control prompt comprising semantic part   names with location and shape clauses. To support this mechanism, we utilize an automated Vision-Language Model (VLM) pipeline to construct a large-scale dataset of multi-granularity partitions and their   corresponding prompts. Driven by this data, FLEXPART generates a view-independent part-identity field in native 3D space, directly assigning discrete part IDs to mesh faces. To compel the model to respect   semantic conditions rather than rely on geometric priors, we train the model using randomized background dropping. Furthermore, an inference-time VLM planner can automatically complete descriptive clauses   from 2D renderings, allowing users to simply name the desired parts in ordinary words. FLEXPART with planner-completed prompts outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 15% in mIoU, even when that   baseline receives ground-truth guidance. On our held-out FLEXPARTBENCH, FLEXPART leads at each granularity and improves average mIoU by 22% over the strongest baseline. With only the requested part names   supplied by the user, it also improves IoU by 35% over the strongest click-driven baseline on selective segmentation.

papers.title_en: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
papers.authors: Motasem Alfarra, Pietro Mazzaglia, Markus Peschl, Daniel Dijkman, Christos Louizos
papers.evidence: 研究机器人策略执行期间的在线自适应
papers.tldr: 机器人运动策略在地形、载荷或传感条件变化时容易失效，而部署端算力、时延与内存限制使重训和人工校准难以实施。论文研究无奖励的在线自监督测试时适应，以冻结的预训练评论家评估并更新策略演员。提出TEMPO，通过熵正则缓解评论家过度自信，并用基于分数的记忆优先处理低价值困难观测、以重要性采样分配有限计算。MuJoCo中多机器人、多种偏移下最高提升80%，实体Go2加小腿载荷实验也改善表现，展示了设备端适应的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

papers.title_en: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Seungmi Choi, Ji-Hyoun Choi, Suhyun Jo, Tae-Gwon Park, Hui Yong Kim
papers.evidence: 从稀疏多视图图像前馈重建并编码三维高斯场景
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯泼溅可由稀疏多视图图像快速重建场景，但现有流程先生成完整高斯表示，再分别压缩几何与外观，难以利用属性间冗余且编码设计复杂。MFGS改为直接编码输入图像的多视图特征，并通过端到端率失真训练，让解码特征共同预测高斯几何和外观。重要性引导的高斯选择还支持从同一比特流适配不同渲染预算。在RE10K、ACID和DL3DV上，相比先生成后压缩，BD-rate节省99.76%至99.86%，总GMAC降低52%至55%，端到端速度约提升12倍，展示了联合特征编码的优势。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.

papers.title_en: SCMerge: Spatial-Consistency-Aware Token Pair Merging for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Junfeng Ren, Yi Gong, Yuan Zeng
papers.evidence: 以空间一致性辅助语义分割中的视觉Transformer令牌合并
papers.tldr: 视觉Transformer在语义分割中表现出色，但注意力计算随令牌数量呈二次增长，限制了实际应用。现有令牌合并多依据特征相似度，忽视空间一致性，可能损害分割结果。SCMerge在编码器中联合特征相似度和空间一致性配对合并令牌，并在解码后重建原始图像块网格，无需训练且可灵活接入现有流程。在ADE20K、Pascal Context和Cityscapes上的实验显示，它比基线方法更好地平衡分割精度与效率，为语义分割模型降耗提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformer architectures have showcased impressive performance on semantic segmentation, yet their quadratic attention complexity hinders practical applications. Recent works have focused on merging tokens to reduce sequence length and thus improve transformer efficiency. However, existing token merging methods primarily rely on feature similarity to identify similar tokens, overlooking spatial consistency, which may introduce segmentation errors in semantic segmentation. In this work, we propose SCMerge, a training-free token merging method that jointly considers feature similarity and spatial consistency in pairing similar tokens. The pairwise tokens are then merged within the encoder, and the resulting token sequences are reconstructed onto the original patch grid after decoding. The proposed method is flexible and can be plugged into existing vision Transformer-based semantic segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments on the benchmark datasets ADE20K, Pascal Context, and Cityscapes show that SCMerge consistently achieves a better trade-off between segmentation accuracy and efficiency than baseline methods.

papers.title_en: SpaceCache: Intermediate Feature Reuse for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on Point Cloud Streams
papers.authors: Dongheon Yang, Beomseok Kang, Jae-Joon Kim
papers.evidence: 复用点云Transformer的跨帧区域特征以加速稠密语义分割
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶与机器人中的点云连续帧高度重叠，但现有语义分割网络仍逐帧从头计算，造成大量重复开销。SpaceCache观察到，点云变换器深层中同一空间区域的中间特征跨帧保持语义一致，因此提出无需训练的特征缓存，让命中区域跳过部分变换器块并复用缓存特征。该方法在nuScenes、Waymo、ScanNet及两种骨干上验证，最高提速1.65倍，且mIoU下降不足1个百分点，优于令牌合并方法。其低开销缓存管理与逐阶段操作提升流式分割效率，同时较好维持预测精度。
papers.abstract_en: Point-cloud streams are central to autonomous driving and robotics, yet existing segmentation networks process every frame from scratch, although consecutive frames largely overlap. We observe that the intermediate features of point-cloud transformers remain semantically consistent across frames for the same spatial region, especially in deep stages. Building on this, we present SpaceCache, a training-free feature cache that reuses these features across frames. Tokens of previously observed regions skip a sequence of transformer blocks and take their cached features, only the remaining tokens are computed, and the full token layout is restored for dense prediction. Lightweight cache management keeps reused features reliable by limiting each entry's age and evicting low-confidence entries. Unlike token merging, SpaceCache selects tokens at negligible cost and runs its cache operations once per encoder stage. On both outdoor and indoor benchmarks, such as nuScenes, Waymo, and ScanNet, with two transformer backbones of Utonia and LitePT-B, SpaceCache achieves up to 1.65x speedup with less than 1-point mIoU drop and consistently outperforms token-merging methods.

papers.title_en: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.authors: Tianjiao Yu, Zhilin Ou, Yifan Shen, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Onkar Kishor Susladkar, Fan Wang, Ismini Lourentzou
papers.evidence: 通过仿真环境与行动策略协同演进训练具身机器人
papers.tldr: 生成式仿真虽能自动构造机器人环境，但环境物理有效不代表适合训练；策略仍需针对自身失败的环境与有效监督。CoDA让数据引擎和动作策略共享异构记忆，依据诊断与学习进展协同演化。视觉语言批评器的诊断被编译为环境生成、训练程序，并借助Text2potential提供分阶段密集监督。四类操作任务的分布外成功率从5.3%升至27.6%，LIBERO-Pro在位置与指令扰动下分别达到84%和76%，显示协同迭代能显著增强策略泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

papers.title_en: Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents
papers.authors: Runhan Huang, Xiangcheng Zhang, Haoyu Chen, Yitong Li, Yen-Jen Wang, Bohan Lyu, Haotian Ye, Chuye Hong, Yixuan Wang, Chloe Su, Haoyu Xiong, Yangzhen Wu, Enze Xie, Travis Manderson, Stefano Ermon, Pieter Abbeel, Antonio Torralba, Dawn Song, Weirui Ye, Yilun Du
papers.evidence: 机器人代理通过在线交互积累经验并生成可执行控制程序
papers.tldr: 机器人学习通常依赖专门采集的遥操作示范，新本体或新任务往往需要重新建库，策略也受模仿数据分布限制。RAX提出以在线探索为中心的机器人智能体：通用编码智能体无需动作示范、手工动作原语或价值函数指导，即可生成控制代码、试错完成任务，并把成功流程编译为模块化程序。系统在仿真及多种真实机器人上评测，探索增加时未见环境泛化持续改善，仿真平均超过顶尖基线37.4%。真实机器人还展现记忆依赖操作、错误恢复、安全防护等能力，表明探索经验可组合复用，支持跨本体持续改进。
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning has advanced by scaling demonstration datasets and model capacity; however, deploying a new robot embodiment or task typically necessitates a dedicated teleoperation corpus. The resulting policies remain bounded by their imitation distributions, limiting generalization and continual self-improvement. We introduce RAX (Robot Agent eXploration), an open-source framework for robot agents centered on scaling exploration: enabling agents to improve by acquiring online experience and synthesizing executable programs. In RAX, a general-purpose coding agent generates robot control code, operating without action demonstration data, hand-engineered action primitives, or value-function guidance. Through online exploration, the agent identifies decision sequences that achieve task goals and compiles them into modular programs encapsulating the full perception-planning-control loop. Using RAX, we present a systematic multi-embodiment study on scaling online exploration across precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks using single-arm, bimanual, dexterous, mobile, and humanoid systems in simulation and on real robots. Generalization performance on unseen environments improves consistently as exploration scales. In simulation, RAX outperforms top baseline models by +37.4% on average. On real robots, RAX autonomously learns memory-dependent, articulated, high-precision, deformable, and long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks without human demonstrations, continually improving performance by composing verified skills from prior exploration sessions. As exploration scales, we observe emergent capabilities including active perception, error recovery, safety guardrails, and human-robot collaboration. We open-source RAX as a generalist robot-agent platform in which new robot embodiments are integrated through their APIs alone, without teleoperated data collection or policy training.

papers.title_en: Towards Reconstructing Geographically Diverse Architecture with 3D Foundation Models
papers.authors: Nicky Kriplani, Yiwen Zhang, Angelina Wang, Hadar Averbuch-Elor
papers.evidence: 评测并分析单次前馈三维基础模型的场景结构重建表现
papers.tldr: 互联网地标照片推动三维视觉发展，但依赖单次前馈推断的三维基础模型在复杂建筑场景重建上仍面临挑战。论文构建ArchWorld基准，覆盖地理范围广、含丰富元数据的建筑地标，并系统分析模型误差及地域差异。研究发现性能差异不仅与训练数据代表性、场景规模有关，也受到地域建筑特征和背景干扰影响；基于此设计干预方案。该方案提升三维基础模型表现并缩小地域差距，为更具地理广度和公平性的建筑重建提供评测与改进依据。
papers.abstract_en: Internet-scale photo collections of real-world landmarks have driven progress in 3D computer vision yet remain highly challenging for modern 3D foundation models (3DFMs) that estimate scene structure in a single feed-forward pass. In this work, we introduce ArchWorld, a benchmark of 3D architectural landmarks with high geographic coverage and rich metadata. We use this benchmark to conduct a thorough error analysis of current 3DFMs to understand where they fall short and how they can be improved. We examine socially relevant disparities in model error and find that model performance varies by geographic region; however, unlike typical fairness regimes, the trends only partially match training data representation. Our investigation reveals that the observed geographic disparities reflect not only differences in data representation and scene size but also differences in region-specific architectural features and background distractors that make scenes from different regions inherently vary in difficulty. Leveraging insights from these model failings, we introduce an intervention scheme that improves 3DFM performance while simultaneously reducing geographic disparities.

papers.title_en: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Jiajun Cao, Kai Tang, Bohua Zhang, Zezhong Qian, Ying Li, Xiaozhu Ju, Xiaobao Wei, Jiaming Liu, Yang Ding, Sixiang Chen, Yiding Sun, Siyuan Qian, Tinghao Wang, Jixian Wu, Yichen Guo, Yi Zhang, Shilong Zou, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.evidence: 统一语言推理、动作生成与世界模型以完成实体操作
papers.tldr: 长程物理操作不仅要求模型生成动作并预测未来状态，还需规划子任务、判断执行进度并适时调整策略。LAW构建闭环视觉语言—世界动作框架，以语义子任务进度串联语言推理、动作生成和世界建模，并通过混合专家、分层视觉记忆及局部价值学习增强决策。在50项RoboTwin任务上平均成功率达94.21%，搭配OpenWAM-α后升至95.56%；真实机器人任务平均成功率为65%，高于对比方法。结果表明，LAW为长程操作提供了兼顾规划与执行的统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

papers.title_en: RoPE-Flow: Monocular Vision-based Robot Pose Estimation via 2D Graph-Conditioned 3D Flow Matching
papers.authors: Liangjing Shao, Wanhao Liu, Zhiwei Fang, Rulin Zhou, Quanlu Zhang, Changjing Liu, Beilei Cui, Yiming Huang, Hongliang Ren
papers.evidence: 单目视觉估计机器人位姿，服务于导航与控制
papers.tldr: 从单目图像估计机器人位姿有助于视觉导航与控制，但二维观测难以可靠恢复三维结构；现有方法还面临迭代渲染耗时、投影歧义、远端关节误差累积和关节学习不均衡等问题。RoPE-Flow提出端到端流匹配框架，从关键点热图提取中心多尺度特征，并通过可学习关键点图生成条件，同时以骨长、射线深度损失及关节加权约束结构和尺度。论文报告该方法在多类机器人、多相机设置中优于现有先进方法，并在新建跨场景基准上展现零样本泛化能力。其设计为单目机器人位姿估计提供了兼顾关键点关系、拓扑一致性与尺度稳定性的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Camera-to-robot pose estimation from a monocular image is significant for vision-based robot navigation and control. However, recovering 3D structural features from 2D observations remains a challenging task. Existing camera-to-robot pose estimation methods either rely on time-consuming iterative rendering or involve sophisticated 2D-3D registration which suffers from projection ambiguity, accumulated errors for distal joints and imbalanced learning for different joints. In this work, we propose RoPE-Flow, an end-to-end flow matching-based framework for camera-to-robot pose estimation. From the predicted 2D heatmaps, we propose a Keypoint-centered Feature Extractor to obtain positional features along with contextual representations from keypoints-centered multi-scale patches. Moreover, we introduce Graph-guided Condition Generator, which embeds a learnable adjacency map to generate condition for flow matching based on correlation among keypoints. Besides, we introduce Bone Length Loss and Ray-Depth Loss for topological consistency and scale stability, with joint-wise weighting to mitigate varied prediction difficulty across joints. The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for pose estimation across different types of robots with mutiple cameras. Besides, we establish a novel cross-scene benchmark to demonstrate the outstanding performance of RoPE-Flow on zero-shot cross-scene robot pose estimation. Meanwhile, animated visualizations are shown on the website: ropeflow.netlify.app

papers.title_en: Q-MAGIC: Quad-only Mesh Autoregressive Generation via Singularity-Aware Circular Relative Offset Tokenization
papers.authors: Yuming Zhao, Zezeng Li, Weimin Wang, Xiang Wu, Na Lei
papers.evidence: 自回归生成四边形网格并重建连通关系
papers.tldr: 三角网格自回归生成已较成熟，但四边形面连接约束更严格，序列化与无歧义重建因此更具挑战。Q-MAGIC 设计面向四边形网格的序列化方案，优先从奇异点布线以形成连贯遍历，并用环形相对偏移表示局部几何。基于该表示，模型通过自回归 Transformer 预测下一词元，实现纯四边形网格生成。实验表明其序列更紧凑，几何保真度和网格质量优于现有先进方法，为四边形网格生成提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive models have proven effective for triangular mesh generation by transforming it into predicting the next face, converting the non-differentiable connectivity prediction into a sequence of token predictions. However, generating quad-only meshes remains challenging because quad faces impose stricter topological constraints than triangles. The model must not only serialize quad faces into a valid token sequence, but also support unambiguous connectivity reconstruction during de-serialization. To address this, we propose Q-MAGIC, a novel autoregressive model for quad mesh generation. We first introduce a tailored serialization scheme for quad meshes, which requires at least two new vertices for the next face and is less flexible than triangles due to strict wiring constraints. To meet these requirements and reduce serialization length, we propose a singularity-aware serialization that prioritizes wiring from singular points, leading to more coherent traversals. Additionally, we propose a circular relative offset tokenization that encodes geometry mainly via local relative offsets. Built upon this representation, an autoregressive Transformer learns the underlying distribution of quad meshes via next-token prediction, enabling effective quad mesh generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-MAGIC produces more compact sequences while consistently improving geometric fidelity and mesh quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title_en: Line-Augmented cuVSLAM: Robust Visual Odometry in Low-Texture Environments
papers.authors: Dara Molloy, Terry Wu, Wonju Lee, Abhilash Nand Kumar, David Adley, Conor Ferguson, Hesam Rabeti
papers.evidence: 利用线特征改进仓库等低纹理环境中的机器人视觉里程计
papers.tldr: 仓库和生产设施中的无纹理通道、重复货架与反光地面，常使依赖点特征的视觉里程计难以稳定工作；与此同时，门框、墙角和货架立柱提供了丰富直线结构。本文将线特征扩展接入 CUDA 加速的 cuVSLAM，以鲁棒点线残差联合优化相机位姿和滑窗地图，并在点特征稀少时自适应提高线特征权重。RGB-D 评测显示，TUM Freiburg3 与 Replica 数据上的平均绝对轨迹误差分别降低 38.5% 和 30.1%，且测试配置均无跟踪失败。该方法沿用原有估计器与求解流程，为低纹理环境提供了有效且可按需启用的几何约束。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots in warehouses and production facilities operate in precisely the environments that defeat point-feature visual odometry: featureless aisles, uniform walls, repetitive racking and specular floors. Such environments are, however, rich in straight-edge structure: rack uprights, door frames, wall junctions and cabinet outlines present high-contrast linear edges stable across wide viewpoint changes. A line-feature extension to cuVSLAM, a CUDA-accelerated visual-SLAM system, is presented that recovers this signal. Lines are parameterised as Plücker coordinates for geometric transport and as the minimal 4-DOF orthonormal representation of Bartoli and Sturm for optimisation; a Cauchy-robust point-to-line residual with analytic Jacobians is folded directly into cuVSLAM's per-frame Gauss-Newton pose solve, and the same line state is jointly refined in the Schur-complement sliding-window bundle adjustment. An adaptive information weight causes lines to assume more of the estimation burden exactly as point features become scarce, and the extension adds residual blocks to existing solvers rather than introducing a second estimator, reducing exactly to the unmodified point pipeline when disabled. Evaluated in RGB-D mode under SE(3) Umeyama alignment with no scale correction, line features reduce mean absolute trajectory error by 38.5% over the 22 sequences of the TUM RGB-D Freiburg3 collection and by 30.1% over the 8 Replica room and office sequences, where median translation error falls by 38.9% and median rotation error by 66.4%, with zero tracking failures in any configuration tested.

papers.title_en: Seeing Both the Forest and the Trees: Reusing Holistic 3D Priors for Part-Decomposed Generation
papers.authors: Yiqun Zhao, Binbin Huang, Haobin Duan, Zibo Zhao, Shenghua Gao
papers.evidence: 将三维资产分解为部件并保持整体结构一致
papers.tldr: 显式部件三维生成不仅要呈现每个部件的几何细节，也要维持部件之间及整体物体的结构一致性；已有整体生成先验具备这两种能力，却通常只输出融合网格。STRUCTPARTS以分割网格脚手架提供结构输入，并让形状潜变量同时处于部件局部与物体全局坐标系，由全局—局部交错变换器共同处理。借助轻量微调，它复用预训练权重中的局部几何与整体结构知识。在PartObjaverse-Tiny上，该方法以更低训练成本达到或超过既有部件分解模型，还支持部件网格细化和部件级编辑。
papers.abstract_en: Generating 3D assets with explicit parts requires two properties at once: geometric detail inside each part and structural coherence across the whole object. Recent image-conditioned 3D generation models adopt a structured 3D representation that anchors tokens to explicit spatial positions, capturing both properties, but their output remains a single fused mesh. We ask how a part-decomposed generation model can inherit both properties of these holistic priors, and answer with STRUCTPARTS, a framework whose core technical contribution is a dual-frame coordinate interleaving mechanism: each shape latent is interpreted under both a part-local and an object-global reference frame, and processed through a global-local inter-leaved transformer that simultaneously reuses the prior's geometric detail at the part scale and its structural coherence at the whole-object scale. As its structural input, STRUCTPARTS uses a segmented mesh scaffold, a coarse mesh paired with a face-level segmentation mask kept entirely within the prior's native 3D representation. With only lightweight finetuning, both intra-part detail and inter-part coherence emerge from the same pretrained weights. On PartObjaverse-Tiny, STRUCTPARTS matches or surpasses prior part-decomposed models at a fraction of their training cost, while naturally supporting part-mesh refinement and part-level editing.

papers.title_en: Dense4D: Pixel-Level 4D Human Correspondence
papers.authors: Rıza Alp Güler
papers.evidence: 前馈模型从单目图像预测人体表面三维点图及深度
papers.tldr: 人体在运动、关节变化及衣物形变中持续改变可见性，如何跨帧追踪同一表面点并恢复一致的四维几何仍具挑战。Dense4D面向人体像素级对应，无需人体模板，联合处理带已知变换的居中裁剪图像，预测公共参考时刻的人体点图及逐图深度。通过点图坐标匹配建立对应，并用深度将匹配提升为三维轨迹，还可定位参考帧中被遮挡的点。真实人物实验显示，其跟踪精度显著优于所测基线，重建表面更贴近扫描结果，展示了跨姿态与服饰形变的稠密一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. Trained specifically for human geometry, Dense4D jointly processes person-centred crops with known image-to-crop transforms to predict Human Point Maps (HPMs) and depth for each image. An HPM assigns each person pixel the 3D position of its observed surface point at a common reference time. These maps support amodal correspondence: points hidden in the reference image can be localised from observations in other frames. Matching HPM coordinates across crops establishes correspondence without predicting camera poses or large scene displacements; per-image depth then lifts the matches into 3D tracks. Experiments on real people demonstrate substantially higher tracking accuracy and closer agreement with scanned surfaces than the evaluated baselines. Points from different frames assemble into coherent human geometry in the reference pose, providing visible evidence of consistent dense correspondence through articulation and clothing deformation. Additional qualitative results, videos, and an interactive viewer are available at https://alpguler.com/dense4d.

papers.title_en: Geometric Queries on Tessellation-Free Displaced Surfaces
papers.authors: Bing Xu, Yang Zhou, Brian Budge
papers.evidence: 无需预先细分网格即可支持位移曲面的几何查询
papers.tldr: 位移贴图能以紧凑纹理表达细节，但传统流程依赖密集三角网格，带来显著内存开销；免细分光线追踪虽已有进展，采样、最近点和镜面流形搜索等查询仍缺乏支持。论文提出一阶纹理空间层级，以局部仿射高度平面和保守残差界描述曲面，支持包围、面积估计及法线斜率约束，并配套查询算法。实验显示其比预细分节省内存、比查询专用基线更快，并用于焦散、发光体采样和曲面方程求解，拓展了位移表面的直接几何查询能力。
papers.abstract_en: Displacement maps encode fine geometric detail in compact textures and simplify surface authoring, but using them typically requires pre-tessellating surfaces into dense triangle meshes, incurring a heavy memory cost. Recent tessellation-free methods enable direct ray tracing. However, broader geometric queries such as surface sampling, specular manifold search, and closest-point queries remain less explored. Supporting these operations requires surface enclosures, area estimates, and normal bounds, which scalar height intervals alone do not fully provide. We present a first-order texture-space hierarchy that unlocks these queries directly without pre-tessellation. Each node stores a local affine height plane and a conservative residual bound, retaining spatial height variation that scalar minimum--maximum bounds discard. The plane and residual provide surface enclosures for intersection and distance searches, while the plane's height and slopes supply area estimates for sampling. Additional slope bounds support specular light-path search. Building on this representation, we develop query-specific traversal, pruning, and sampling algorithms, and demonstrate them in caustics rendering, sampling displaced emitters, and surface partial differential equation (PDE) solvers. We demonstrate memory savings over pre-tessellation and performance improvements over query-specific baselines, while retaining efficient ray tracing.

papers.title_en: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Rong Li, Shijie Li, Jiangyong Huang, Lingdong Kong, Jiaming Zhou, Dongyue Lu, Zeying Gong, Baoxiong Jia, Junwei Liang, Siyuan Huang
papers.evidence: 学习视觉语言模型读取由RGB恢复的几何信息，支持度量与多视图理解
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型难以从 RGB 图像中掌握度量关系与多视角结构，而提取或对齐几何特征并不意味着模型会使用它们。GeoReader 先以冻结模型解码的几何描述监督轻量读取器，使几何信息转化为目标模型可读的连续令牌；随后冻结读取器，并依据问题将几何令牌注入模型进行空间问答微调。推理时模型直接使用令牌作答，无需生成几何思维链。方法在 MindCube-Tiny 上取得 94.3 分，并在六项其他空间基准上平均达到 72.5，强调几何表示应服务于接收模型的实际推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

papers.title_en: MonoMIP: Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping for Monocular 3D Object Detection
papers.authors: Emir Ulurak, Furkan Kıraç
papers.evidence: 通过多高度逆透视映射构造度量鸟瞰特征以增强三维几何推理
papers.tldr: 单目三维目标检测常借助深度引导变换器，但仅在透视图像平面推理，透视缩短会扭曲空间关系。MonoMIP提出双解码框架，以多高度逆透视映射构建从地面到车顶的度量鸟瞰特征，并由鸟瞰解码器聚合不同高度证据，再与透视空间的深度引导三维解码器互补。该方法无需额外训练数据，在KITTI车辆中等难度三维检测上，验证集AP达25.84%，官方测试集达21.66%，并在KITTI和Waymo上优于近期已发表的单目方法。其贡献是将多高度几何信息引入单目检测，提升空间推理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection methods increasingly rely on depth-guided transformers, but they operate entirely in the perspective image plane where spatial relationships are distorted by foreshortening. We propose MonoMIP, a dual-decoder framework that adds complementary 3D geometric reasoning through Bird's-Eye View (BEV) features constructed via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping. We perform IPM at K elevation planes spanning ground to rooftop, producing an ordered stack of height-conditioned metric BEV features that reduces above-ground misprojection and exposes depth-dependent appearance variation across planes. A BEV decoder with multi-scale deformable attention aggregates this multi-height evidence per query, while a depth-guided 3D decoder provides complementary perspective-space predictions. Without extra training data, MonoMIP attains 25.84% Moderate AP3D|R40 on KITTI val and 21.66% on the official test set for Car, outperforming recent published monocular methods on both the KITTI and Waymo benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE
papers.authors: Yuhang Hu, Junlin Lyu, Yuan Fang, Xiaoying Shen, Lechen Zhang, Jiong Lin, Judah Goldfeder, Steven Tian, Hod Lipson
papers.evidence: 机器人感知场景对象并生成目标条件下的身体运动
papers.tldr: 在人机交互中，注视由眼睛、头部和眼睑协同表达，固定追踪规则难以复现其时间结构，机器人因而需要同时确定注视目标并生成合适动作。论文将异步视觉语言模型的场景目标选择、反应式注视维持与动作生成分开处理，并提出以人类动作记录训练的RGT模型。该Transformer-VAE根据双眼轨迹生成协调的颈眼运动，另由眨眼预测器触发眼睑动作。在共用真实目标的两秒基准中，RGT-Base的七关节整体误差最低，实机演示也验证了流程可运行。研究展示了机器人空间运动拟合与实时推理能力，但感知自然度及开放词汇目标选择准确性仍待受控评估。
papers.abstract_en: Gaze coordinates attention in human interaction through coupled eye, head, and eyelid motion. A humanoid robot must choose where to look while generating a suitable movement toward that target; fixed tracking rules alone do not model the temporal structure of human gaze. We separate these tasks with an asynchronous vision-language model that selects a scene referent, a reactive perception module that maintains fixation, and a Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) that generates target-conditioned motion. RGT is a Transformer-VAE trained on markerless human recordings retargeted to the robot's 11-DoF joint space: self-supervised pretraining encodes recent full-head history, and autoregressive fine-tuning exposes the model to its own predictions during rollout. At inference, a four-dimensional binocular-eye trajectory conditions coordinated neck and eye motion; an auxiliary blink predictor triggers eyelid templates during playback. On a two-second benchmark in which all controllers receive the same ground-truth target, RGT-Base obtains the lowest reported overall seven-joint MSE, and physical demonstrations show the integrated targeting and control pipeline. The evidence establishes robot-space kinematic fidelity and real-time RGT inference; perceived naturalness and open-vocabulary target-selection accuracy remain questions for controlled evaluation.

papers.title_en: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
papers.authors: Jahyeok Koo, Hyeonseo Yu, Seungho Jang, Jaewoo Jung, Jiwon Kang, Seokju Cho, Seungryong Kim
papers.evidence: 利用相机几何和三维理解改善新视角生成
papers.tldr: 从有限观测生成新视角，不仅要保留场景外观与几何结构，也需理解物体身份、属性和相互关系；既有方法较少显式建模这些高层语义与空间信息。本文提出 Ask4NV，基于预训练多模态模型，将相机几何融入视觉表示，并通过联合注意力利用空间理解特征辅助生成。实验表明，该方法兼具较强图像质量、几何一致性和有竞争力的三维语言理解能力。联合训练还改善了跨视角特征对应，显示空间问答监督可为新视角生成提供互补信号。
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.
